recommended_reusable_cohort.selection: The already frozen readiness-only roof10 cohort: first six chronological sessions calibration and final four holdout. It was selected before reception scoring.
recommended_reusable_cohort.per_session_probe_geometry: Each visit has one receiver-0 and one receiver-1 TrackingProbe with common visit_index, probe_index, probe_start_ms, channel, edge, and valid_start_counter. Every cached input reports probe_ms=20 and probe_start_ms=0.
recommended_reusable_cohort.cache_validation: All 10 immutable cache SHA-256 values match evaluation_inventory; every TrackingInput and timing receipt is qualified; all receiver counterparts and their common lane/start counter were present.

pairing_summary.rule: existing fixed 2.2 microsecond modulo-frame tolerance plus 10 kHz alias-aware CFO tolerance, after a calibration-only 2380.1434201757074 Hz receiver CFO bias

model_rows.limitation: These rows are detection-selected anchors. physical_pair_key and observation_utc_ns identify conditional paired observations, but a null physical_pair_key is common and does not identify an absent target.

interfaces.local_reuse: pickle protocol-5 TrackingInput caches listed in evaluation_inventory; the cache is a frozen local analysis artifact, not a portable public contract.

geometry_and_calibration.authority: gauss-r20-roof-20260926-v1; one radio, nominal 0.08 m mount separation, nominal 10 degree outward tilt, RX0=physical RX1 west/270 degrees and RX1=physical RX2 east/90 degrees.
provisional: Software-to-physical RX mapping is explicitly provisional, not a cable trace.
RF phase centers, directed baseline, elevation, world tilt, and surveyed altitude are unknown.
Operator WGS84 roof coordinates are not a survey.
geometry_and_calibration.interpretation: A fitted temporal crossing can test conditional consistency under this nominal mapping. It cannot calibrate a physical beam pattern, establish an absolute azimuth, or support blind location validation.

four_class_feasibility.same_target_labels_for_both: available only for candidate pairs meeting the frozen CFO/epoch compatibility rule
four_class_feasibility.same_target_labels_for_rx0_only_or_rx1_o: conditional only: the detected anchor is known, while its counterpart is absent or incompatible in that same receiver-paired probe
four_class_feasibility.blocking_reason: A raw paired probe with no compatible candidates supplies an opportunity but no target identity. Existing persistent tracks and model_rows begin from detections and do not trace a named target through a missing window. Assigning neither to a track would require source-specific identity association; using all outcomes to construct it would leak test outcomes.
four_class_feasibility.training_only_frequency_cfo_rule: Not available as a sealed reusable labeling artifact. The existing frequency/CFO graph is detection-conditioned, and no stored contract assigns target identities to raw no-detection windows using only training data.

permitted_next_use: A bounded conditional temporal model may use detected-anchor tracks, their observation_utc_ns, receiver identity, positive fractional margins, and same-probe counterpart outcomes. It must label receiver-missing outcomes as conditional-on-anchor and omit neither. A full four-class target model is blocked pending a frozen training-only association/forecast artifact that maps target opportunities before held outcomes are inspected.
